newsitem.title: USA: Illinois Power to meet with NRC next week.
newsitem.headline: Illinois Power to meet with NRC next week.

text.p: The Nuclear Regulatory Commission said Friday it will meet with Illinois Power Co March 4 to discuss findings from a recent inspection of the utility's Clinton nuclear power plant near Clinton, Illinois.

The NRC said operating deficiencies and a failure to perform required safety evaluations for changes in spent fuel cooling procedures will be among the topics that will be covered at the predecisional enforcement conference, which will be open to the public.
"We have been over these issues before with the NRC," an Illinois Power spokesman said. "We are in general agreement with the NRC and can provide a few more details on these issues."
The agency said the issues are separate from a pending decision on apparent violations connected to a September 5 shutdown of the Clinton plant.
The NRC added the decision to hold the conference next month does not mean a violation has occurred or that enforcement measures will necessarily be taken.
Illinois Power is an energy services holding company.
